title: Data Analyst
intro: I turn log and event data into root causes, clear reports and faster decisions, using SQL and Python.

skills.name: Analysis
items: pattern detection in large event datasets

bullets: Analysed **30–40 operational and security events a day (~700 a month)** across email, identity and endpoint data sources in a 24x7 environment.
Queried large log datasets with Google SecOps UDM searches to trace brute-force and password-spraying patterns to source IPs and list every affected user.
Root-caused recurring account lockouts to **3 sources** (cached credentials, Citrix profiles, Cisco ISE Wi-Fi) by correlating sign-in, device and network data.
Combined data from **4 platforms** (Entra ID, Proofpoint, CrowdStrike, ServiceNow) to build a single view of each case and speed up decisions.
Documented findings in structured tickets and RCA reports with evidence for every action.

achievements: Automated a data-heavy alert workflow in Python, cutting handling time from **~15 to ~3 minutes (80% faster)**.
Replaced **~30 minutes of manual data lookups and actions with a ~3-minute script (90% faster)** for bulk account operations.

bullets: Completed paid usability and feedback tests evaluating websites and applications, providing structured, detailed feedback under platform confidentiality terms.
Completed **25+ tests**, maintaining a consistent quality and completion record.
Collected, cleaned and labelled a text dataset.
Engineered TF-IDF features and evaluated a classifier over 15 rounds to reach **98.5% precision and recall**.
Merges alert data with **3 external data sources** (site directory, manager lookup, weather API) to produce enriched notifications.
Logged **13 findings** in a structured dataset with CWE mapping, severity and root cause.
